reviews.comment:
Cargo bastante seguido acá y la verdad no he tenido inconvenientes. El tema es el poco espacio que hay sobre Beiro para hacer fila, complica bastante las cosas. El Full la verdad la atención más que buena, es pequeño pero cumple, el empleado me ayudo con una promoción en la app que no podía aplicar, fueron muy amables. Luego la comodidad, la limpieza, el café y las medialunas estuvieron diez puntos. Además tiene las oficinas del ACA al lado, un punto extra a favor.

(Translated by Google)
I fill up here quite often and honestly, I haven't had any problems. The issue is the limited space on Beiro Street for queuing, which makes things a bit complicated. The Full service was more than good; it's small but does the job. The employee helped me with a promotion on the app that I couldn't use; they were very kind. The comfort, cleanliness, coffee, and croissants were all excellent. Plus, it has the ACA offices next door, which is an extra point in its favor.
